Welcome to the Delayed Render Fixture

This page simulates a React/Vue-style SPA: this paragraph and heading are present in the initial HTML document, exactly like real static/SEO content often is, but the actual interactive control below is injected by JavaScript after a short delay - mirroring how client-side hydration works on a real site (see wiki/crawl4ai-integration-pitfalls.md's "wait_for= css:body is satisfied by the pre-hydration shell" entry for the real bug this fixture regression-tests).
